# Function Showcase

These PNGs show the app's Windows controls and dialogs at their default opening sizes. Drive records, activity entries, and displayed paths are fictional demonstration data. The Terminal screenshots show the tab before its session is enabled.

Each function has a Light Theme and Dark Theme screenshot, with `_light_mode` or `_dark_mode` at the end of its filename. The GIF shows Light Theme, then Dark Theme for each function, at 4.5 seconds per frame. Smaller windows are centered without scaling. The PNGs preserve the original image quality; GIF palette conversion can reduce color detail.
